summary: Verified merchant module header UI parity fix. My Partners, Commission, and Partner-detail pages now all render the ROUNDED gradient CARD banner (borderRadius 24, drop shadow, blue→purple gradient, translucent icon box, decorative circles) INSIDE the scroll content with page margins — matching the already-correct My Customers style and web panel. No flush edge-to-edge bars observed. Merchant login (one-click demo) and downstream KPI cards, tabs, search, partner list, and partner detail all rendered correctly with live data.
verified_flows: Merchant one-click demo login → merchant home loaded (Sharma Electrics, CR9Z6…)

/merchant/partners: rounded gradient card 'My Partners' with subtitle + Network icon, KPIs (Total Commission ₹385, 1 partner), status tabs, partner-search input, and 1 partner row (Raj Kumar PTR-C0A949 Active, ₹385 commission) all visible.
/merchant/commission: rounded gradient card 'Commission' with subtitle + TrendingUp icon, 8 KPI cards, All/Customer/Partner tabs, commission-search, date filter visible.

Partner detail: tapped Raj Kumar row → partner-detail testID rendered rounded gradient card 'Partner' / 'Referred partner commission' with detail-back link, avatar, status pill, KPIs, service-wise commission list, privacy note.
critical_code_review_comments: MModuleHeader default (non-card) variant is still exported but no longer referenced by these three pages — safe to keep, but confirm no other screen depends on it before pruning.

boxShadow on card variant is a web-only CSS style (native RN would need elevation/shadow*) — currently OK because this Expo build is web-served, but for native builds add elevation/shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius/shadowOffset to preserve depth on iOS/Android.
test_credentials: Merchant one-click demo login (label 'Login as Merchant' on /login) — no phone/OTP required. Phone +919000000002 / OTP 123456 also documented per request.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Merchant referral screens (partners/commission/partner-detail) now use MModuleHeader card variant. TestIDs: merchant-partners, merchant-commission, partner-detail, partner-row-<id>, detail-back.
